summary: Native Windows C++ compile fix verification via MinGW-w64 (posix) cross-compiler syntax-only check. Confirmed the ICodecAPI undeclared identifier bug is fixed by the added '#include <strmif.h>' before '#include <codecapi.h>' in MediaFoundationH264Encoder.cpp. All 3 relevant translation units pass -fsyntax-only with zero errors. SwDevice.cpp fails only on missing swdevice.h (expected, MinGW does not ship it; real Windows SDK does).
critical_code_review_comments: Include order in MediaFoundationH264Encoder.cpp is correct: <strmif.h> (line 4) precedes <codecapi.h> (line 5), with an inline comment explaining why (ICodecAPI declared in strmif.h; codecapi.h only defines CODECAPI_* property GUIDs). Good defensive documentation to prevent regression.

All 3 ICodecAPI usage sites verified: line 108 (ComPtr<ICodecAPI> codec in CreateEncoder), line 337 (keyframe request in EncodeFrame), line 437 (ApplyBitrate). All SetValue calls use CODECAPI_* GUIDs that exist in codecapi.h (AVEncCommonRateControlMode, AVEncCommonMeanBitRate, AVLowLatencyMode, AVEncVideoForceKeyFrame).
Regression grep clean: no residual references to wmcodecdsp / CLSID_VideoProcessorMFT / converter_ anywhere under windows/SecondScreen.Native/src/. Dead MFT converter path fully removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MinGW syntax-only cross-compile command reference: cd /app/windows/SecondScreen.Native && x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix -fsyntax-only -std=c++17 -DUNICODE -D_UNICODE -DNOMINMAX -DWIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN -I include -I ../../shared/protocol/cpp <file>. Use -posix variant (not plain win32) so std::mutex/std::thread are available. SwDevice.cpp will always fail with 'swdevice.h: No such file or directory' under MinGW — expected, not a regression. Final compile authority is user's GitHub Actions CI with MSVC.
